instruction: Fix `nested_get` so it returns None when a key in the dotted path is missing instead of raising a KeyError.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore.py b/datastore.py
--- a/datastore.py
+++ b/datastore.py
@@ -42,6 +42,8 @@
 def nested_get(obj, path):
     """Return the value at a dotted ``path`` (e.g. 'a.b.c') or None if missing."""
     for part in path.split("."):
+        if not isinstance(obj, dict) or part not in obj:
+            return None
         obj = obj[part]
     return obj
